workflow.name: inspect_sources
workflow.purpose: Inspect caller-approved local files and draft manifest and mapping records.
workflow.stopCondition: Stop if the builder rejects secrets, unsupported formats, oversized files, or leakage indicators.

workflow.name: handoff_to_source_intake
workflow.purpose: Classify builder drafts into confirmation, more-data, replacement, or method-gating next actions.
workflow.stopCondition: Do not continue to method gates unless the handoff says proceed_to_method_gating.

workflow.name: run_method_gate
workflow.purpose: Bind accepted source intake to setup benchmark and method decisions without creating forecasts.
workflow.stopCondition: Do not create artifacts unless the method gate awaits explicit setup forecast execution.

workflow.name: execute_forecast
workflow.purpose: Run explicit setup forecast execution for the confirmed handoff only.
workflow.stopCondition: Blocked setup forecast runs must not bind forecast IDs or artifact paths.

workflow.name: resolve_forecast
workflow.purpose: Resolve and score the generated handoff forecast from declared outcome sources.
workflow.stopCondition: Do not score blocked handoff cases or use resolution sources as forecast-time evidence.

workflow.name: read_forecast_card
workflow.purpose: Read compact probability, baseline, resolution, score, and claim-boundary fields.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-card --id forecast-1102 --question-id question-1102
workflow.stopCondition: Stop if the card does not preserve handoff and method-gate bindings.

workflow.name: read_lifecycle_bundle
workflow.purpose: Read the bound forecast lifecycle for audit context and provenance review.
workflow.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-bundle --id forecast-1102 --question-id question-1102
workflow.stopCondition: Use the bundle for audit context, not as a new source of forecast semantics.

workflow.name: read_track_record
workflow.purpose: Inspect the one-outcome track record and sample-size claim boundary.
workflow.stopCondition: Do not generalize one resolved handoff outcome into a calibration or quality claim.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use before execution to inspect source-builder handoff, method-gate, and forecast-run state.
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Treat source-handoff and method-gate summaries as guidance, not generated forecasts.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use after forecast execution to check source-handoff resolution fixture drift.
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Only generated forecast-1102 is resolved; blocked handoff cases stay non-scored.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use for compact probability, baseline, resolved outcome, score, and claim boundary.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-card --id forecast-1102 --question-id question-1102
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Do not hide sample-size warnings or source-handoff setup bindings from downstream agents.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use when the caller needs the bound forecast lifecycle and provenance context.
readSurfaceChoices.cliCommand: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-bundle --id forecast-1102 --question-id question-1102
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: Use for audit context without redefining forecast, evidence, resolution, or scoring semantics.

readSurfaceChoices.whenToUse: Use after resolution to inspect Brier score, baseline comparison, and one-outcome boundary.
readSurfaceChoices.agentRule: One resolved source-handoff outcome is not a calibration or quality claim.

guards.name: mapping_confirmation_gate
guards.rule: Unconfirmed builder mappings must ask for confirmation before method gates or forecast execution.

guards.name: blocked_cases_no_forecast
guards.rule: Blocked source-handoff cases must not bind forecast IDs, question IDs, cards, bundles, or artifacts.

guards.name: blocked_cases_no_score
guards.rule: Blocked source-handoff cases must not create resolution, scoring, calibration, or track-record outputs.

guards.name: resolution_source_boundary
guards.rule: Declared outcome sources may resolve outcomes but must not enter forecast-time provenance.

guards.name: sample_size_boundary
guards.rule: One resolved source-handoff outcome must keep quality and calibration claims blocked.

guards.name: local_fixture_boundary
guards.rule: The source-handoff setup runbook describes local fixture behavior, not hosted private API parsing.

commands.expectedSignal: draft manifest and mapping from caller-approved local files

commands.command: python3 scripts/ope.py read --record-type forecast-card --id forecast-1102 --question-id question-1102
commands.expectedSignal: resolved scored forecast card with source-handoff setup binding
one resolved outcome with sample-size claim boundary
